source.title: Irish News, 19 May 1949, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the district electoral divisions of Ballymoney rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. The Irish News nomination list of 19 May gives the retiring members returned for nine divisions; contests were pending in Seacon and Kirkmoyle, whose results were not found in the Belfast or Irish News reports, so those two divisions are not listed here. Returned unopposed.
